newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Chernogorneft Q1 pretax up to 99.6 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia Chernogorneft Q1 pretax up to 99.6 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Company's full name is AO Chernogorneft . Holding company SIDANKO owns 50.73 percent of voting shares in Chernogorneft.
Figures prepared to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis. Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West.

Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
